A3_S5_D2: ^Chione: There you are! The calf wanted me to give you this.
^Chione: Yes! Monsteratops tend to wear these, with more decorative materials as they age.
^Chione: It's a sign of appreciation for your help.
^Narrator: After rambling a little, Chione finally remembers—
^Chione: Right! You were curious about how Thavmia prepares for the floods, weren't you?
^Chione: In the month leading up to the flood, the settlements around the base of the island gradually gather their possessions and pack them into carts.
^Chione: There's another settlement living in the mountains, you see — and as generations came to pass, they've made progress exploring the caverns around their home.
^Chione: They work year-long to maintain and expand the tunnels, so that when the time came, the island can file in and wait out the floods.
^Noelle: How would you know when to come out? And how are the caves sealed?

^Chione: Yes, but those who stay outside, even if they're Ichthyos… face a pretty big risk.
^Narrator: You can imagine. Even on clear days, just a strong gust of wind could be deadly to boats off-shore.
^Chione: And this year, there's talk of the Krakenfolk joining the Ichthyos outside, since they're used to living near the waterfall, as well.
^Narrator: Chione gestures to you with a smile.
^Chione: Krakenfolk have incredible physical strength, after all. Though I didn't know just one of you could move ruin blocks!
